scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:ts
scripts.build:native: swift build -c release --arch arm64 && swift build -c release --arch x86_64 && lipo -create .build/arm64-apple-macosx/release/libEventKitBridge.a .build/x86_64-apple-macosx/release/libEventKitBridge.a -output libEventKitBridge.a && node-gyp rebuild --arch=arm64 && cp build/Release/eventkit.node /tmp/eventkit-arm64.node && node-gyp rebuild --arch=x64 && lipo -create /tmp/eventkit-arm64.node build/Release/eventkit.node -output build/Release/eventkit.node
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build
